scope: Serialized GPU kernel event seconds, including endpoint reconstruction and tail work. Host expansion, packing, transfer and array construction are excluded. This is a conditional M62/F40 sample with improved checks through K50 and no K38 walkback, not the earlier saved K38 corpus or an end-to-end mixed-A pipeline.
comparison_note: A10, A9, A8 and the closing A10 control ran in separate blocks. Ratios compare medians, not paired repetitions. Each trial total sums the corresponding separately timed class runs. Observed timing ranges are not confidence intervals.

corpus.digest_note: FNV-1a over the ordered eight-byte little-endian source residues; deterministic identifier, not a cryptographic hash.
corpus.selection: Unique uniform baseline M62/F40 draws; reject first improved13 cull at depth <=50. Improved culls after K50 do not reject. No K38 walkback filtering.

config.sum_scope: For each repetition index, sum the separately timed classes. Classes are measured in contiguous blocks to keep their arrays resident.
config.timing_scope: Serialized CUDA kernel event seconds, summed over classes. Host expansion, packing, transfer and array construction excluded; no end-to-end mixed-A pipeline is measured.
config.validation_scope: CPU/GPU exact endpoint, case, iteration, hash and flag comparisons on descendants of the first 16 source endpoints at every A.

runner_scope_note: The executable config defines this microprobe's corpus and timing scope; generic runner descriptions of K38 pipeline runs do not apply.
